invariants.rule: GlassHelix owns scientific evidence, hypotheses and inference policy; Cellerator owns reusable numerical execution, derivatives and residency. The experiment is an independent installed client, not core biology.
Population snapshots are not individual histories; clone membership is shared ancestry, not row pairing. Withheld targets and ATAC-derived features cannot enter unauthorized fitting or conditioning.
Numerical failure, failed optimization, unresolved explanations and biological uncertainty are distinct. Candidate agreement is not a uniqueness proof; no observation or result is fabricated.
Preserve NF1A source and successful evidence, unrelated work, preprint content and separate Todo authorities. No historical retirement, runtime replacement or broad cleanup is authorized.
Build one real end-to-end learning slice before broadening capabilities. Reuse native execution and qualification; create durable tasks only for durable outcomes or ownership boundaries.

tasks.title: First evidence-to-hypothesis learning slice
tasks.objective: Aggregate the five verified local outcomes. This is a closure record, not a coordinator seat or a prerequisite of its children.

required: All five local outcomes meet their executed engineering acceptance; any used Cellerator change has producer and installed-consumer evidence.
Close with separate toolkit, experiment-client and biological-run status. Missing biological inputs never become a claimed biological success.

tasks.next_action: Close last after GH-L1-ACCEPT. Do not claim this epic to obtain implementation ownership.

tasks.title: Repair the two inference correctness defects
tasks.objective: Recheck and repair right-nullspace extraction and persistent log-weight handling; preserve the existing native interfaces where possible.

required: Native tests exercise nontrivial rectangular DGESVD right-nullspaces, multiple null directions and the existing scale convention; do not rely only on 2x2 controls.

Finite likelihood evidence never irreversibly prunes a candidate through weight underflow. Native tests distinguish explicit zero priors and deliberate pruning, and test evidence-order/batch equivalence for fixed conditionally independent evidence.
Current tests call the actual repaired library. Include affected existing regressions; source-derived review probes are evidence seeds only.

tasks.motivation: The next learner will rely on these diagnostics and candidate updates. Two focused repairs are cheaper than propagating incorrect confidence.
delegated_choices: Choose concrete APIs, implementation sequence and narrow delegation; names in DESIGN.md are concepts, not mandatory classes.

tasks.title: Learn executable candidate systems from observations
tasks.objective: Deliver one reusable learning path over NF1A: evidence and unknowns, native evaluation, full selected gradients, fitting, authorized conditioning and fitted candidate persistence.

required: A truth-known partial-observation client genuinely fits at least one shared law coefficient and one local initial/hidden quantity from unknown values; it is not only reweighting pre-supplied answers.
Differentiate the complete executed objective through model, observation and evidence terms; accumulate shared-parameter contributions across repeated uses and instances using CE numerical owners.
Use actual retained forward operands, reject stale or mismatched response traces, distinguish structure changes from value generations, and demonstrate reuse across value updates.

Keep five concerns separable: evidence views, hypothesis families, learning problem/unknowns, inference strategy and fitted explanations. Do not require five abstract base classes or a new universal graph.
Freeze shared learned quantities during held-out conditioning; infer local unknowns only from permitted inputs. Retain explicit whole alternatives and search coverage limits.

Save and reload logical fitted quantities and scientific/evidence identity; a fresh process reproduces predictions. Expose a useful native client or high-level binding without requiring full framework GPU interchange.

tasks.motivation: This is the missing observations-to-systems loop. Implement it as one coherent slice rather than freezing disconnected interfaces.
delegated_choices: Default to a small fixed-structure family, training-only feature map, short horizon, saved primals and a simple optimizer. A horizon map is a legitimate first realization.
Audit the required CE operations once. Reuse existing verified primitives; activate the separate CE plan only for a demonstrated numerical gap.
Add bounded unknown forcing when needed to exercise the selected family; unrestricted inputs cannot explain away every residual.
DATA provides pressure but is not a hard predecessor: proceed using the generic controlled client when public data is delayed.

tasks.title: Run the isolated experiment client
tasks.objective: Connect the audited CellTag adapter to the learning toolkit and implement one explicit experimental protocol with fair baselines and separate biological status.

required: The client uses installed public/developmental package interfaces, never private CE source inclusion or a parallel production solver/AD implementation.

Implement one coverage-supported arm: blind population-law learning, retrospective reconstruction, or prospective family-history prediction. Enforce its evidence cutoff and state its claim accurately.
Exercise one small horizon model and one modest alternative when data supports their comparison, with same-authorized-information non-dynamical control; no universal latent model is required.

For available bounded real data, execute and record at least a feasibility fit/evaluation. If inputs are unavailable, run the installed client on explicitly synthetic format fixtures, ship the real-run configuration and mark biology not_run_inputs_unavailable.

Keep ATAC grounding separate, use clone-held-out partitions, preserve mixed-clone observations, and avoid interpreting observed cell fractions as intrinsic fate probabilities. No performance victory is required.

charter.objective: Turn incomplete observations into fitted executable candidate explanations through the existing GH/CE foundation.
charter.motivation: Fast scientifically meaningful progress: one useful reusable slice and one separate experiment consumer, not another foundation rewrite.
charter.desired_end_state: Installed learn/condition/predict/persist path, explicit alternatives and evidence access; independently runnable CellTag client with honest biological status.
boundaries: No historical NF1/NF1A retirement, new ledger authority or unrelated source cleanup.
No GH numerical or AD framework duplicating CE; no CellTag biology in core.
Experimental defaults are provisional. No universal Markov/neural/deterministic/uniquely identifiable model is imposed.
acceptance_conditions: Five GH outcomes pass their actual required gates; final report separates engineering and biological results.
charter.delegated_judgment: One responsible main thread chooses APIs, solver, sequence, model simplification and bounded children. Serial lane is a cheap default, not an instruction to waste independent work. New first-class lanes require an authorized supported plan amendment.

lanes.motivation: Main thread owns implementation judgment and can delegate bounded children without a separate coordinator bureaucracy.
delegated_choices: Create required test gates once commands exist; use finish_task for their execution.
Serial writable ownership by default; children have narrower existing targets and no cross-authority write privilege.
